messages.content: You are a helpful assistant that rewrites GNU C++ code into functionally equivalent variants. The code reads and writes I/O from the console.

<perturbed_code_1>
#include <iostream>
#include <cstring>
#include <vector>
#include <string>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstdio>
#include <iomanip>
using namespace std;
typedef long long ll;

ll x, y, n;

int main() {

	cin >> x >> y >> n;
	
	ll a, b, ta;
	double mn = 214748364.0f, t;

	for (ll tb = 1; tb <= n; tb++) {
		ta = (tb * x) / y;
		t = abs(tb*x - ta*y) / (y*(tb+0.0));
		
		if (t < mn) {
			a = ta, b = tb;
			mn = t;
		}
		
		ta++;
		t = abs(tb*x - ta*y) / (y*(tb+0.0));
		if (t < mn) {
			a = ta, b = tb;
			mn = t;
		}
	}

	ll l = (ll)sqrt(max(a, b) + 0.0);
	for (ll i = 2; i < l; i++)
		while (a % i == 0 && b % i == 0)
			a /= i, b /= i;

	cout << setprecision(10) << a << '/' << b << endl;

	return 0;
}
</perturbed_code_1>
